description: Enterprise techniques used by DCSYNCER.SLICK, ATT&CK software S9065 (v1.0)
name: DCSYNCER.SLICK (S9065)

techniques.comment: [DCSYNCER.SLICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9065) has gathered stolen credentials in hardcoded filenames and pathways to include `C:\users\public\LOG.txt` and `C:\Program Files\VMware\VMware Tools\VMware VGAuth\LOG.txt`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)

[DCSYNCER.SLICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9065) has staged stolen credentials in hard-coded local device paths to include `C:\Program Files\VMware\` and `C:\users\public\`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DCSYNCER.SLICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9065) has been executed using DLL search order hijacking.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)

[DCSYNCER.SLICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9065) has stored stolen credentials in legitimate resource locations to include `C:\Program Files\VMware\VMwareTools\VMwareVGAuth\LOG.txt`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DCSYNCER.SLICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9065) has utilized dynamic API resolution to conceal functions.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DCSYNCER.SLICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9065) has XOR-encrypted stolen credentials prior to writing them to files.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DCSYNCER.SLICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9065) has gathered credentials using DCSync Active Directory replication feature.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
